text:
micah: quick micro-slice snapshot for the new candidate (strato13b) — ran 3 slices (chat multi-turn, longform recall, rerank) across fp16, int8, int6. TL;DR: int6 -> ~48% token cost reduction vs fp16, avg GTN quality delta ~ -1.2 pts; longform recall drops more (~-3.8 pts) on narrow-domain prompts.
maria: can you paste the high-level numbers?
micah: sure, small paste below:
```
slice | fp16 score | int8 score | int6 score | token cost (fp16=1.0)
chat  | 86.4       | 85.9      | 85.0      | 1.0 / 0.62 / 0.52
recall| 78.9       | 77.4      | 75.1      | 1.0 / 0.62 / 0.52
rerank| 91.2       | 90.9      | 90.2      | 1.0 / 0.62 / 0.52
```
jonah: ok so int8 is almost neutral for chat/rerank, int6 is where recall degrades.
sam: what's the unit-econ break even for product? assuming average prompt length 150 tokens, 100k req/day.
micah: rough calc: fp16 ~ $0.14k/day, int8 ~ $0.087k/day, int6 ~ $0.073k/day (in our pricing buckets) — so switching fp16->int6 saves ~48% monthly.
tia: product asks for guidance: recommended routing & safe canary %?
ryan-product: product here — we need guardrails. If longform recall is critical we can't default int6. Could we route by intent?
micah: yes. suggested policy: default -> int8 for 80% traffic, heavy-longform -> fp16 or int8 with kvcache warmstart for 10%, int6 for low-risk paraphrase/summary paths (10%). Canary: 5% for 24h with latency + recall checks.
bench-bot: perf snapshot uploaded: https://bench.internal/runs/1849990000 (contains per-seq latency histograms) :chart_with_upwards_trend:
eval-bot: small eval note — on GTN slice 'legal-forms' int6 precision drop triggers signal in production rules (F1 delta -4.1). Recommend blocking int6 for legal intents until curated priming.
maria: ok actionable: 1) run 5k-sample longform ablation on int6 w/ priming prompt set 2) implement routing flagging by intent + token-length 3) canary plan 5% 24-72h with automated rollback if recall F1 drops >2 pts.
sam: timeline?
micah: I'll queue sample run today (ETA results in 6h). tia can draft product note for GTN.
tia: on it, will include recommended routing + business tradeoffs.
ryan-product: thanks — include the P&L delta and recommended user-impact messaging for GTN.
micah: adding quick checklist for ops: 
- deploy int8 model as baseline
- gate int6 behind feature flag + intent classifier
- add eval callbacks: recall-F1, chat-coherence, latency-tail (p99)
- canary 5% -> 24h -> 72h escalation
Micah: will update with numbers after the 6h run. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
